title: HANDOFF
description: Cold-open memo written into workflow/handoffs/<date>.md before ending a session. Human form: workflow/templates/HANDOFF.md. A handoff is a headed document, not a FIELD: value record; its machine form is the first line plus the set of required '## ' headings found in the body, which is exactly what scripts/onboard_check.py checks.

header.description: The file must start with '# RESUME HERE' (the template: '# RESUME HERE -- written <date>').

sections.description: Required '## ' headings, keyed by their canonical text. The checker matches each heading as a substring of the body, so a heading may carry a suffix (the template's '## OPEN QUESTIONS -- do not let these die unrecorded').

## THE WHOLE JOB, IN FOUR LINES.description: 1. the single most important thing to do or protect; 2. the second; 3. the third; 4. the fourth -- if you need five lines, the project has a focus problem.

## BINDING RULES RIGHT NOW.description: Anything that must not happen, with the reason -- a DO-NOT list beats a to-do list.

## EVERY NUMBER WORTH CITING.description: Measured values only, each with provenance (file/receipt + date). Anything not listed here is not citable without re-verification.

## OPEN QUESTIONS.description: Numbered, each with what resolving it requires. Do not let these die unrecorded.

## WHAT NOT TO DO.description: The tempting wrong moves, and why they are wrong.

required: ## THE WHOLE JOB, IN FOUR LINES
